Use case: stylized-concept. Production art for Riley Wheel Brawl 2.0, Stage 4, Shadar Logoth. Asset story4_panel_3.png. Canvas exactly 1280×720. Single image, not a sprite sheet. Fully opaque. HOUSE STYLE, identical to spike-art/HOUSE_STYLE.txt: HOUSE STYLE (Riley Wheel Brawl 2.0), identical for every image:
- Hand-drawn HD 2D fighting-game sprite art in the spirit of Streets of Rage 4: confident dark-brown/near-black ink outlines (thicker on the outer silhouette, thinner inside), clean cel shading with 2-3 tone steps plus subtle painterly gradients. NOT pixel art, NOT 3D render, NOT photo-real, NOT chibi.
- Lighting baked lightly: soft key light from the upper LEFT, gentle cool rim on the right edge. Keep shading moderate (the game adds real-time light on top).
- Rich but grounded colors. Strong readable silhouette.
- Side view (profile / slight 3/4), character faces RIGHT, full body head to boots, whole figure inside the frame with margin.
- Genuinely TRANSPARENT background (real alpha). No ground shadow, no floor, no text, no labels, no borders, no frame numbers. Story panel. Fog curling through the arch. Mordeth is unseen: no face, no body, only the welcome of the fog. Opaque painting, 1280×720. No text, letters, numbers, watermarks, frame labels, or borders in the finished image. No gore: Shadowspawn become ash; human cultists are knocked out or flee.
